original_test_intent: Validate every Type 45 Firmware Component Name string as the exact approved identity of its firmware component and associated handles, including valid string reference and stable inventory mapping across reboot.
original_method: Confirm Type45 revision/layout support, validate record/string bounds and raw name index, resolve exact text, disambiguate duplicates through associated handles/other fields and correlate read-only firmware inventories before/after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the component/name/handle baseline and approves reboot; exact string and inventory correlation are automated and read-only.
required_inputs: Expected Type45 component inventory and exact/alias naming policy
Associated device/firmware handle mapping and duplicate/blank/OEM policy
Read-only BMC/Redfish/UEFI/OS inventory and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not update firmware, reset BMC, change boot settings or component state.
Validate the raw string index/bounds before using the name.
Do not treat a non-empty/familiar name as unique identity; use associated handles and approved mapping.
Stop on firmware/management health loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate Type45 support/layout/name index, preserve exact string, map each record/associated handle to approved firmware inventory and diff semantic identity across reboot.
Report blank/dangling, duplicate/ambiguous, mislabeled, missing or drifting components without PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve Type45 capability, name/alias and component-handle inventory plus reboot plan.
Adjudicate OEM/duplicate naming exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is relevant, but grep cannot prove string reference, structure support/bounds or component identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw/decoded Type45 and read-only inventories; emit record handle/name index/exact name/associated handles/component identity and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The component-name scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no firmware change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the exact name string within each Type45 record, disambiguate it using associated handles and authoritative read-only inventory, and compare semantic component identity across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS Type45 capability, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and inventory-source versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 45 Firmware Component Name/string and associated-handle definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds capability/layout, string-index and identity mapping rather than accepting formatted text.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects dangling indices, duplicate-name collisions, names attached to the wrong component and inventory drift.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: External inventories may use aliases; only explicit mappings may normalize names, and Type45 absence must be judged against platform capability policy.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define aliases, duplicates and Type45 applicability, but must preserve exact firmware text and associated-handle identity and cannot trigger an update to fix metadata.
expected_evidence: Approved Type45 capability and component/name/handle inventory
Pre-reboot raw Type45 handles/lengths/string sets and name indices
Exact resolved names with associated-handle/external inventory identity
Approved reboot/firmware-management health record and semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Firmware Component Name is a defined Type45 string; platform capability and expected inventory are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String/inventory correlation is fully automatable after approved inputs; unsupported Type45 is a project applicability result, not an ambiguous test.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds capability/layout, string reference, handles and semantic component identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-update safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates inventory/reboot inputs and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible or duplicate name from passing when it resolves from an invalid index or identifies the wrong firmware component.
independent_technical_reasoning: A firmware component name is a string reference within a structured inventory graph; correctness requires valid resolution and identity association, not textual familiarity.
